Define the Overlay: Use the sl-popover component as the container for your additional information.
Prototype Setup:Select the Infotip component.
Switch to the Prototype tab and create a connection (noodle) to your sl-popover frame.
Set the interaction to On click -> Open overlay.
Set the position to Manual and align it relative to the icon.
Enable "Close when clicking outside" for the expected behavior.
